mensagens.input: Jason and Rabin are doing a chemistry experiment for a science class. They are in a step where they must add acid into a beaker, but Jason thinks the amount of acid Rabin is adding does not match with his; Jason thinks it's a little more. Use the number line to find out whether Jason is right.
Jason is using 15/8 flasks of acid.
Rabin is using 13/7 flasks of acid.
-----,No; Jason actually has more acid.,Yes; Rabin does have more acid.,No; Jason was not right. Both have the same amount of acid.
